e_prs_osteo.head: Your genome report puts you in a higher band for bone strength.

e_menopause.head: You told us you are past the menopause.

e_col1a1.head: You carry a small change in a gene called COL1A1. It links to bone strength.

e_prs_cm.head: Your genome report puts you in a higher band for heart and weight health.

e_fto.head: You carry a small change in a gene called FTO. It links to body weight.

r_strength_who.head: Muscle work helps everyone. People are advised to do it 2 days a week.

r_impact_loading.head: When both of those are true, loading your bones is the thing with the best evidence behind it.

r_balance_falls.head: Balance work helps you stay steady on your feet.

r_balance_older.head: Past 65, people are advised to do balance work 3 days a week.

r_cardio_who.head: People are advised to aim for 150 minutes a week of activity that warms you up.

r_cardio_fto.head: For people with this gene change, being active makes the gene matter less.

r_peak_who.head: Short bursts of hard effort count double towards your weekly aim.

r_mobility_blueprint.head: Stretching is part of a well-rounded week. The evidence here is weaker.

r_adapt_yoga.head: You already do yoga, so we picked a yoga version rather than something new.
r_adapt_yoga.design_note: Preferring an existing habit is a product choice. The health claim is the bone-loading one it builds on.

r_adapt_weights.head: You already lift weights, so we added a ride to the end of a session you already do.
r_adapt_weights.design_note: Preferring an existing habit is a product choice. The health claim is the aerobic one it builds on.

r_adapt_walk.head: You already walk every day, so we added balance moves to your walk.
r_adapt_walk.design_note: Preferring an existing habit is a product choice. The health claim is the balance one it builds on.

p_need.head: This battery is the emptiest one this fits.
p_need.design_note: How empty the battery is comes from your watch and the aim for that battery. It is not a new health claim.

p_daypart_fit.head: This suits this time of day.
p_daypart_fit.design_note: Which time of day suits which activity is our practical choice, not a health claim.

p_habit_fit.head: This is something new for you, so it ranks a little lower than a version of what you already do.
p_habit_fit.design_note: Preferring an existing habit is a product choice, not a health claim.

r_sleep_evening.head: Hard exercise late can make it harder to drop off.

p_taste_less.head: You asked for less like this, so it ranks lower.
p_taste_less.design_note: Your own likes and dislikes change the order. That is your choice, not a health claim.

p_taste_kind.head: You asked for less of a few things like this, so this kind ranks a bit lower.
p_taste_kind.design_note: When you turn down a few of the same kind, we learn from that. It is your choice, not a health claim.
